salary_details.details: The position is on a purely contract basis initially for one year and is extendable based on performance.

selection_process: Candidates will be short-listed for Test/Interview on the basis of information provided in their online applications. The Institute reserves the right to decide the mode of screening and testing the applicant for shortlisting and selection.
how_to_apply: Go to the official online application website at https://icandsr.iitm.ac.in/careers/current_openings.php.
Check the advertisement number Advt.208/2026 and select the relevant position.
Register using your login ID (email) and fill out the online application form.
Select multiple positions if applying for more than one position before submission, as the system accepts a single application per registered login ID for an advertisement.
Review all entered details carefully, as the application cannot be edited or reverted once submitted.
Submit the application online on or before 23.10.2026.
Obtain and keep a printout of the submitted application form to produce when called for document verification, test, or interview.
important_instructions: All positions are on a purely contract basis, and completion of the contract period will not confer any right for further extension, regularization, or permanency. Candidates must be citizens of India (or subjects of Nepal or migrants from Pakistan with proper eligibility certificates from the Ministry of Home Affairs). Applicants working in any project at IIT Madras must apply through the proper channel or produce a No-Objection Certificate at the time of document verification/test/interview. Relevant experience gained after the minimum qualifying degree will only be taken into consideration. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. Hard copy of the application is NOT to be sent to the Institute unless called for a test. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

faq.question: Q1. What is IIT Madras Project Research Scientist II (Non-medical) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a temporary recruitment notification released by IIT Madras under advertisement number ICSR/PR/Advt.208/2026 to hire 1 Project Research Scientist II (Non-Medical) for the Department of Chemical Engineering.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Research Scientist II (Non-Medical) post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of online application is 23.10.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a First-class PG degree with 3 years of experience or a PhD, or a Second-class PG degree with a PhD and 3 years of experience. For Engineering / IT / CS, a First Class Graduate degree of four years with three years of experience is required.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for IIT Madras Project Research Scientist II (Non-medical)?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive Rs. 67,000/- plus HRA (30%), making a total of Rs. 87,100/- per month including HRA.
